dataset: V2X-Sim 2.0 mini, scene_5 (Town03 intersection), 100 frames @5 Hz
pipeline: detections (road-side unit + other vehicles' front cameras) -> Guardian fusion -> swarmsight.conflict

start_check_prediction_only.note: same check on ground-truth positions and velocities (perfect perception): the prediction logic alone

start_check_definition: label: had the waiting ego started now (2 m/s² from rest, straight on), its footprint would have come within 0.5 m of the road user's actual footprint within 6 s; road users moving >= 1 m/s, crossing or oncoming, not behind

thresholds.set: a priori, not tuned on this scene
